schema: VietlishCorpusEntry (src/lib/tutor/vietlishCorpus.ts) — { vietlish, natural, sourcePattern, category, frequency, context }
author: A10
definition: Sixth-wave Vietnamese-L1 interference review candidates (human review before any promotion into VIETLISH_CORPUS). Wave 6 mines fresh territory under-covered by waves 1-5: Vietnamese greeting/social-register calques, household-chore calques, workplace/office Vietlish, daily banking & medical calques, school/study, modal+bare-infinitive errors, quantifier/determiner errors, purpose/reason connectors, proverb/idiom calques, and additional false friends. A few natural 'control' anchors are flagged in sourcePattern for abstain-checking.
dedupedAgainst: live VIETLISH_CORPUS(353) + all 5 merged wave files(993) + A4 promotion list + Stage-1 128 paste block — 1346-item denylist, zero overlap (asserted by the guard test vs live + verified at authoring vs the full denylist).
